title: Recognize the One within before you teach
summary: The line pulls the self away from convenience and back toward what can still be spoken with honor. Keep this close: Hold onto this: knowledge without inward freedom still serves attachment.
takeaway: Say the cleaner thing and keep it.
lifeApplication: Before correcting someone, posting the quote, or giving the lesson, touch the chest and ask if the line has entered your own conduct. Do not use sacred language to stay unexamined.

source.shortMeaning: Knowledge ripens only when the One is recognized within.
source.lifeApplication: Before teaching, ask whether the truth has already changed your own heart.
